methodology.notes: Custom submission: first voice-banking (voice + knowledge) entry. Identical to the standard voice evaluation pipeline (audio-native, regular speech complexity, ElevenLabs eleven_v3 TTS, Gemini thinking level HIGH) but run on the banking_knowledge domain with retrieval-config=alltools, and the user simulator LLM is gpt-5.5-2026-04-23 at reasoning_effort=xhigh instead of the leaderboard-standard v1.0 (gpt-4.1). Not comparable to standard-user-simulator leaderboard entries.
